title: Two violations: the first failing fact decides the error
notes: Fact 0 has tx 99 > basis.tx 10 (a basis violation). Fact 1 has the impossible instant 2026-13-01 (a value violation).
Section 4.4 step 3.2 checks fact by fact, each fact fully before the next, so fact 0 fails first: W0.E_BASIS.
One pass per check (every value first, then every tx) would give W0.E_VALUE; that reading is wrong.
